pair_pool_source: reuse the exact frozen 32-pair pool from V25_PUBLIC_COUNTER_CARRY_TRANSITION_SIGNATURE_AUDIT; no new pair selection
observable_definition: For each observed target output Z, counter c and every candidate key k in 0..1023, compute the exact 32-bit subtraction borrow mask for feed-forward inversion word4: Y4(c,k)=Z4(c)-S4(k,c) mod 2^32. Pair descriptors summarize the two candidate-ensemble borrow-mask distributions without identifying or using the true candidate.
primary_scope: word4 feed-forward subtraction only; bits0..15 statistics plus whether borrow reaches bit10; no trail-score shape descriptors
control: same public carry-transition feature matrix used by the killed carry family, re-fit on these fresh targets with fixed Ridge(alpha=1.0)
forbidden: selecting the true candidate before aggregation
label: oracle_rank_percentile from the exact pair-score matrix; synthetic training/evaluation only
model: StandardScaler + Ridge(alpha=1.0), fixed; three target-group folds
null: 256 within-target label permutations, recomputing grouped CV; fixed seed
stop_rule: All gates must pass. Failure closes this borrow-descriptor family; no second development set and no addition of score-shape features to rescue it.
next_if_pass: freeze borrow model and open untouched descriptor-only fresh ranking validation
next_if_fail: search for a non-aggregated algebraic self-consistency observable across candidate trajectories/round boundaries; do not keep adding summary statistics
pair_pool_coordinates_canonicalization: JSON compact list [[distance,a,b],...] in carry-plan pair order
